content.text: Tracyton Movie HouseAt your fingertips.Switch to appLogin to enjoy exclusive benefitsSign InAboutContact UsWWE: Wrestlemania 202620264h 0mNow ShowingPlay TrailerSportsRelease Date04/18/2026Tickets go live03/24/2026Buy TicketsSynopsisWrestleMania 42 ("WrestleMania Vegas") takes place on April 18–19, 2026, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada. Following the 2026 Royal Rumble, the event is set to be headlined by Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk for the World Heavyweight Championship, with Liv Morgan challenging for a top women's title. Key Details and Projected Matchup Scenarios:Venue & Date: Allegiant Stadium, Paradise, NV, on April 18-19, 2026.Main Event (Projected): Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk for the World Heavyweight Championship.Women's Feature: Liv Morgan (2026 Women's Royal Rumble winner).
